fusions.name: Lignum Vitae
fusions.desc: A blow with dense, iron-hard wood that deals 30 damage, ignores armour, and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Rustleaf Spray
fusions.desc: Shakes rust-coloured spores across a cone 3.5 tiles long, dealing 4 damage with a 40% chance to leave each enemy [Hindered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Petrified Bark
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you; transcendent damage still lands. You restore 12 health.

fusions.name: Slow-Grown Grain
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 10%, every ability you have comes round 5% sooner, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
